name: Mirror Bali
description: is a popular nightclub and lounge in Seminyak, Bali, known for its striking Gothic cathedral-inspired interior, state-of-the-art lighting, and immersive atmosphere. It hosts world-class DJs and themed events, offering a high-energy, stylish nightlife experience with premium drinks, bottle service, and a sophisticated dress code. The venue features a large dance floor and a unique design with features like stained-glass windows and mirrored walls, creating a glamorous and electrifying party scene.
openingHours: Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday & Sunday: 22:00 – 03:30 (Closed Monday & Tuesday)
priceRange: Entry fee (FDC) typically ~Rp 150.000 for men (redeemable for drinks/food); women often free before 00:00. Typical drinks ~Rp 100.000–150.000; VIP / bottle-service / high-end events range ~Rp 250.000–500.000+ depending on event.
